thread:
Tess (Content): Quick sync — interviewed Aurora Pulse today. We got a clean bite about time-to-market and a short technical quote about throughput. Need legal on the technical line and the lead routing set before we publish.

Omar (PMM): Nice. Can you paste the hero quote you want? Also what's the launch window?

Tess (Content): Hero quote candidate: "Redwood cut our model deployment time and let us iterate faster across teams." Tech quote candidate: "End-to-end throughput improved by ~2.5x on our production pipeline" (this one might need redaction). Launch window: aim for 2 weeks (target 2026-07-09).

Priya (AE): Aurora wants inbound leads from the case page to go to their Solutions Ops queue first, then fall back to our enterprise SDRs after 48h. Also ask to tag campaign=aurora_pulse_q3.

crm-bot: To add routing provide comma-separated key=value pairs. Example: lead_source=case_study,owner=team-x.

Priya (AE): Use: lead_source=aurora_pulse_case,owner=aurora-solops,fallback_owner=redwood-enterprise-sdr,followup_delay=48h,campaign=aurora_pulse_q3

Rolf (Legal): Read transcript. Two items: 1) remove the raw ratio "2.5x" unless Aurora confirms a public metric; replace with "more than doubled throughput" or leave as qualitative; 2) redact mention of a third-party vendor. Send final phrasing and I'll sign off.

Tess (Content): Proposed edits based on legal: Hero: "Redwood cut our model deployment time and let us iterate faster across teams." Tech line (edited): "End-to-end throughput more than doubled on our production pipeline." Removed vendor refs.

Omar (PMM): For the landing headline I'd pair the hero with: "How Aurora Pulse accelerated releases and scaled inference without rearchitecting services." Also we should plan a webinar two weeks post-launch for joint demo.

Rolf (Legal): Approving the edited tech line and hero, given Aurora's verbal OK. Rolf (Legal) :white_check_mark:

Nadia (Producer): Uploading clips to Drive and creating the 60s hero cut. Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/aurora-pulse. Need final copy and headshots. Can we get a short (10-15 word) attribution line from the customer?

Priya (AE): Attribution: "Maya Lin, Head of ML, Aurora Pulse". Confirmed. Also confirmed the CRM payload above.

crm-bot: Routing rule scheduled to staging. Reminder: deploy to prod 1 hour before publish.

Tess (Content): Thanks everyone. Next steps: I will drop final quote into the doc, tag @Rolf if anything else changed, and send to design. Omar, will add webinar to the launch checklist for 2026-07-23.

Omar (PMM): Sounds good. I'll take care of the webinar invite template and co-presenter notes.
